description: Source code for DNS reloader functionality in Chromium, handling system DNS configuration changes on POSIX systems with res_ninit support.

classes.name: DnsReloader
classes.description: Manages DNS reloading upon system DNS configuration changes, observing network DNS changes and reinitializing resolver state.

methods.name: OnDNSChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when DNS configuration changes, increments resolver generation.

methods.name: MaybeReload
methods.description: Reloads DNS resolver state if DNS configuration has changed.

methods.name: DnsReloaderMaybeReload
methods.description: Triggers DNS reloader to check and reload DNS configuration if needed.
